summary: Batch A + B + C enhancements validated end-to-end on preview URL. Toast overlay UX fix confirmed (Toaster bottom-right, bb=(1540,1056) in 1920x1080 viewport; header-restaurants-galore remains visible+clickable immediately after 'Saved' toast). All 21 launcher tiles present. Recipe 'Cook this again' works: 1st click → toast 'Cooked! (1× total)', 2nd click → 'Cooked! (2× total)', list card shows 'cooked 2× · last: less than a minute ago'. PhotoAttachPanel (attach-photo-btn + attach-photo-input) renders inside Recipe / Coupon / Review editors after first save. Delivery editor has new data-testid='delivery-driver-phone' input; saved row exposes delivery-dial-<id> anchor with href='tel:555-1234'. Family sync: family-sync-btn present, click fires toast 'Synced 2 birthday reminders to your notes' (Kai 03-14 + Alex 07-21). Glass theme: glass-toggle-row + glass-toggle present in Backup modal; toggle ON writes body[data-rg-glass='true'] and localStorage rg_glass_theme='1', toggle OFF writes 'false', setting persists across full page reload. Pre-visit briefing regression PASS — directory-brief-<id> opens modal with allergy warnings (Kai — avoid peanuts) and live coupons (PHOTO20). Zero React 'unique key' warnings, zero console errors across the full flow.

batch_results.coupon_photo_attach: PASS — attach-photo-btn visible inside coupon-editor after save.

batch_results.family_birthday_sync: PASS — family-sync-btn present; toast 'Synced 2 birthday reminders to your notes' fires. Note: direct IndexedDB verification of the two 🎂 notes was not possible in the same-run because Playwright launches a fresh browsing context after reload; the toast + StorageService.saveNote code path (RestaurantWorkspacesP6.jsx L362-378 writes category='Restaurants', title='🎂 <name>'s birthday', tags include 'birthday','family','restaurants') provide sufficient proof.
batch_results.glass_theme_toggle: PASS — body[data-rg-glass] transitions true→false→true; localStorage rg_glass_theme='1'; setting survives full page reload.
batch_results.pre_visit_briefing_regression: PASS — pre-visit-briefing modal renders with allergy warnings and live coupons.

action_items: (Nice-to-have) Family birthday input in RestaurantWorkspacesP6.jsx L480 has no data-testid — currently addressable only by placeholder='07-14'. Consider adding data-testid='family-birthday' for future automated tests.

(Nice-to-have) Edit/Delete icon-buttons inside recipe-row, coupon-row, review-row, delivery-row still lack per-id data-testid. Automated Edit flows currently rely on positional selectors (button.nth(1) etc.). Add data-testid={`<resource>-edit-<id>`} / `-delete-<id>` for robustness (same gap flagged in iteration_31).
critical_code_review_comments: PhotoAttachPanel.jsx is a clean, well-scoped shared component. The disabled hint 'Save first, then attach photos' is defensive but rarely reached because all four callers (Recipe/Coupon/Review + existing Order gate) render the panel only after isEdit=true (id exists). Consider passing an explicit prop to hide the whole panel in un-saved state, so the file input isn't even in the DOM pre-save.

handleSyncBirthdays uses a deterministic noteId=`rg-bday-${m.id}`, which is idempotent — re-clicking Sync updates the same note instead of duplicating. Good. However, if the user renames or deletes a family member, the orphan birthday note is not cleaned up. Add a cleanup pass (delete rg-bday-* whose family id no longer exists).

glass-theme.css targets `[role="dialog"][data-state="open"]` globally — this affects EVERY Radix dialog in the app when the toggle is on, not just Restaurants Galore modals. Verified visually the Backup dialog frosted correctly, but any non-RG dialog (e.g. note editor, settings) will also be glassed. If unintended, scope the selector under a container class instead of body attribute.
delivery-dial-<id> uses `d.driver_phone.replace(/\s+/g, '')` before writing into tel: — good for spaces but keeps hyphens (tel:555-1234 works, so acceptable). No further sanitization needed.

Toaster is duplicated in both /app/frontend/src/App.js:31 and /app/frontend/src/NotesApp.jsx:1279 (both position='bottom-right'). Two Toasters render two <ol> lists; sonner deduplicates via portal but this yielded duplicate toast text arrays in test output ('Cooked!','Cooked!','Saved','Saved'). Cosmetic — end-user sees one toast, but consider removing the App.js-level Toaster since NotesApp.jsx already renders one.
seed_data_creation: Restaurant 'Batch Bistro', family members Kai(03-14, allergies=peanuts) and Alex(07-21), Recipe 'Home Ramen', Coupon 'PHOTO20', 1 Review (food=5★), 1 Delivery (Sam, 555-1234, 25min) — all created in-run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Same as iter_31: IndexedDB is per-Playwright-context, so seed data must be created within the script. Aggressive dismiss loop (tour-skip / tour-skip-inline / qa-close / qa-skip-forever) needed at start + after modal-close. For editing existing rows without per-id edit testids, use `.locator('[data-testid="<resource>-row-<id>"] button').nth(N)` — order per row: coupon [toggleUsed,edit,delete], recipe [cook,edit,delete], review [maps?,edit,delete] (only 2 buttons observed — no maps because rating stars are inside the row body). Family birthday input has no testid — use `input[placeholder="07-14"]`. Two Toasters in DOM (App.js + NotesApp.jsx) cause every toast text to appear twice in Playwright's all_text_contents(); use `any(...)` matchers rather than equality on toast arrays.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. Iteration_32's toast-overlay blocker is fully resolved (Toaster position='bottom-right' in both App.js:31 and NotesApp.jsx:1279).
